## Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like.

## Scientific use case
What MD analysis does this enable, and why is it useful?
<!-- e.g. "SASA over time to track pocket opening", "radius of gyration", "secondary structure timeline", "contact maps", "free energy landscape" -->

## Expected input
What data format / file would feed this feature?

```
example input columns or file snippet
```

## Expected output

<!-- A reference figure or paper showing the analysis is very helpful. -->

## Alternatives considered
Any current workaround you use, or other tools that do this.

## Additional context
Anything else (references, equations, color schemes, etc.).
